blocks.en: Labs that grow Arabidopsis in liquid medium usually improvise the setup with foam cut to size, mesh taped over a container, or a fixed plate above a reservoir. None of it repeats between labs, or even between runs in one lab.

blocks.en: The first version was a fixed plate over a liquid chamber, so the level of the medium had to be set by hand before every run.
blocks.text: The first version was a fixed plate over a liquid chamber, so the level of the medium had to be set by hand before every run.
blocks.zh: 最初的版本是架在液槽上方的固定板，因此每次試驗前都得用手把培養液的液位調好。

blocks.en: The level has to sit just under the plate, as high as possible. Too low and the roots lose contact; too high and the plate floods. The window is narrow.
blocks.text: The level has to sit just under the plate, as high as possible. Too low and the roots lose contact; too high and the plate floods. The window is narrow.
blocks.zh: 液位必須剛好落在板子下方，而且盡可能高。太低，根會失去接觸；太高，板子會被淹過。可用的區間很窄。

blocks.en: The level also moves. The plants drink and the medium evaporates, so a level set at the start of a run is wrong by the end. Every top-up lets conditions drift between replicates, and we wanted to remove that step.
blocks.text: The level also moves. The plants drink and the medium evaporates, so a level set at the start of a run is wrong by the end. Every top-up lets conditions drift between replicates, and we wanted to remove that step.
blocks.zh: 液位還會變動。植物會吸水，培養液也會蒸發，所以試驗開始時調好的液位，到結束時已經不對了。每次補液都讓各重複組之間的條件產生偏移，我們想把這個步驟去掉。

blocks.zh: 我們從 Conn 等人（2013）的水耕方法1出發：幼苗放在填滿瓊脂的座子裡，根泡在 ½ MS 培養液中，水槽保持不透光以抑制藻類，培養液每 2–3 天更換一次。第一個容器照著這個方法做，是一個大型不透光的水槽，上面放一塊板子承載種子座（填了瓊脂的黑色微量離心管蓋）。

blocks.en: Each box grew seedlings, and each failed differently. The black tank was far too big for five seedlings, its foam board was fragile and slow to make, and it was too deep and dark to see the roots or cloudy medium. The small box leaked at its joint and through its bottom when carried, even with black tape over the bottom, and its lid fell in unless set down at one exact angle. The tall clear box held the medium and showed the roots, but its board fitted so tightly that changing the medium was awkward, and it was too narrow for more than a few plants.
blocks.text: Each box grew seedlings, and each failed differently. The black tank was far too big for five seedlings, its foam board was fragile and slow to make, and it was too deep and dark to see the roots or cloudy medium. The small box leaked at its joint and through its bottom when carried, even with black tape over the bottom, and its lid fell in unless set down at one exact angle. The tall clear box held the medium and showed the roots, but its board fitted so tightly that changing the medium was awkward, and it was too narrow for more than a few plants.
blocks.zh: 三個盒子都能把幼苗養起來，但各有不同的失敗。黑色水槽對五株幼苗來說太大了，泡棉板既脆弱又費工，而且槽太深、太暗，看不見根，也看不出培養液是否混濁。小盒子在搬動時從接合處漏液，底部也會漏，即使底部貼了黑膠帶也一樣；蓋子除非以某個精確的角度放下，否則會掉進盒裡。細高的透明盒子裝得住培養液，也看得見根，但板子卡得太緊，換液很不順手，而且太窄，放不下幾株以上的植物。

blocks.en: So the container has to be clear, to watch the roots and the medium; deep enough for the roots; one watertight piece, carried to the bench every 2–3 days; wide enough for 5–13 seedlings; and fitted with a board that lifts out.
blocks.text: So the container has to be clear, to watch the roots and the medium; deep enough for the roots; one watertight piece, carried to the bench every 2–3 days; wide enough for 5–13 seedlings; and fitted with a board that lifts out.
blocks.zh: 所以容器必須是透明的，才能觀察根與培養液；深度要夠根生長；要是單件不漏水的結構，因為每 2–3 天就得搬到工作檯；寬度要容得下 5–13 株幼苗；還要配一塊可以整塊取出的板子。

blocks.en: The plate carried the plant team’s salinity pre‑test, with four boxes of one plate each, for a control and for pre‑, co‑ and post‑treatment with CH Bio peptide (a commercial peptide from CH Biotech that helps plants resist abiotic stress) at 1:500, all under 100 mM NaCl for 7 days. The boxes were photographed from above on July 25, July 28 and August 4. By the last date the co‑treatment box had the largest and greenest rosettes and the post‑treatment box the palest; the co‑treatment plants also had the highest fresh weight and chlorophyll content. This pre‑test used the earlier plate, from before its CAD was revised on 11 August (User Testing).
